test: execute checks against the current file. Each check starts from a FRESH initial page. Include prerequisite actions in that check. All fields required. text="" means any text. changed=true requires a visible state change during actions. Reset tests must first change state. finish: give a concise summary only when the latest source has successfully run and your requested interaction tests passed. Failed/stale runs and tests cannot be overridden. You are responsible for checking completeness against the original request; startup alone does not prove requested functionality.
Tool errors are observations: correct the action or inspect files, then continue. Keep code and observations concise. Do not claim to have tested something without executing it.

Build a compact offline browser application called Agent Counter. Show a heading, a visible count starting at 0, an Add button that increases it by one, and a Reset button that restores zero. Use a dark background with readable text. Both controls must work repeatedly.
